g.text: `spf_sv_fsm.cfg` · every tuning knob in one file: round count, timings, start cash, per-weapon bonus
`spf_sv_fsm_init` · binds the round machine to map begin and to client begin, die, spawn, disconnect
`bombplant_init` · subscribes the bomb to the same hooks plus use press and release
admin and player commands · `.play`, `.spec`, and one `dm/<mapname>` function per map with hand-placed sites
the two PDFs · the author's own SoFplus scripting course, read by humans, nothing reads them
wait for players · 1 s timer re-execs itself, starts only with 2+ players, restarts the map after 24 h
count down · 3 s of broadcast numbers, then round start
plant it · 500 ms ticks up `G_bomb_plant_timer`, then spawn a `misc_generic_wpn_c4` entity
defuse it · 500 ms ticks to `G_bomb_defuse_timer` 5000, player frozen
check once per second · explosion, defusal, elimination or timeout picks a winner
end the round · clears bomb state, pays loser money with a streak up to a 3400 cap, prints scores
pick a bomb carrier · walks every slot for team 2, `sp_sc_cvar_random_int` over that list
bomb sites · dust2002 A and B hardcoded in init, per-map `dm/<name>` in `bombplant_areas.func`
`sf_sv_play_sound_queue.func` · one sound per slot at a time, chained by length cvar
`ent_helper.func` · entity field wrappers, and `spawn_a_trigger` builds each site box
`killfeed.func` plus `spf_sv_fsm_rh` · kill rows drawn in screen space, round scores at the end
`-bp_damage.func` · damage accounting, disabled by the leading dash in its filename
`G_bomb_*`, `G_round_ended`, `bp_round_inprogress` · all game state is server cvars
`_sp_sv_info_map_count` · token every timer carries, so a map change strands stale loops
no files, no database · a map change is a full reset, cash and streaks included
SoFplus script VM · `spf_sc_list_add_func`, `sp_sc_timer`, `sp_sc_flow_*`, quoted cfg values
SoF.exe · entity spawn and field set, `slotSoundPlay`, `sp_sv_client_spec`, `sp_sv_client_swap`
`dm/*.bsp` · each map name must also have a `dm/<name>` function, or it keeps the dust2002 boxes
SoFplus scripting manual · the language reference the two PDFs teach and the scripts assume
the cfg tunes it, the init functions wire it into engine events
every rule is a cvar write, then read back by a timer
entity, sound and team calls, all through SoFree command names
